newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Vanstone says jobs growth outlook positive.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Vanstone says jobs growth outlook positive.

text.p: Australian Employment Minister Amanda Vanstone said on Thursday the fall in Australian employment in February was not unexpected given the volatility in the statistical series.
"We need to continue to make the structural changes necessary to support faster economic growth.

"The outlook for increases in the employment growth rate appears to be very positive, with business investment growing strongly and the effects of recent interest rate cuts yet to flow through," said in a statement.
Vanstone said the February data showed that the labour market remained flat, with adjusted unemployment rising to 8.8 percent from 8.6 percent and adjusted employment falling.
In a statement, she said "such a fall in adjusted employment was not unexpected given the volatility in this series".
"The trend series is a more reliable indicator of the state of the labour market," she said. "These show that 108,000 jobs have been created since March last year."
Adjusted employment fell 7,200 in February, compared with economists' forecasts for a rise of about 10,000.
